contentPattern.structure: single external widget/profile URL rendered as a centered third-party embed

suitableFor: third-party review / social-proof widgets referenced by URL (Trustpilot, Feefo, review banners)
script-driven rating widgets embedded via a profile/review URL
compact centered embeds of external trust/rating content
notSuitableFor: external video embeds with a poster and play affordance (use embed-video)
self-hosted video files (use the vanilla video block)
full interactive forms (out of scope; use static links)

usage.notes: Reused twice on the car-insurance page (Section 3 top Trustpilot banner and Section 14 'Read more about our customer's experiences' widget). Represents the Trustpilot review profile (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.admiral.com) as a static embed; live star rating is script-driven and not in the scraped HTML.
